rounds.text: Simmonds Marshall Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading at a modest P/E of 14.7x while delivering exceptional return metrics such as an ROE of 25.35% and ROCE of 19.85%, both well above their respective sector benchmarks [E1, E9, E10]. Profit growth has been explosive, highlighted by a 71% increase over the trailing twelve months and a 94% surge over three years, complemented by operating margins expanding by 7 percentage points over three years to reach 14% [E21, E20, E30]. The business translates these earnings into robust financial strength, generating Rs 31 Cr in operating cash flow and Rs 29 Cr in free cash flow, representing a cash conversion rate of 2.07x where profits are fully backed by actual cash [E35, E36, E34]. This fundamental outperformance is supported by a strong sectoral tailwind in the Automobile & Auto Components industry, a relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500, and a rules-based screen score of 94 out of 100 indicating high conviction [E69, E49, E60]. Conceded: debt exceeds net worth with a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.16x, annualised volatility is high at 77.8%, and the stock trades at a price-to-book ratio of 3.73x which exceeds the sector benchmark [E38, E52, E7].
